_note: cart pump A v2 main board (mechanical/CART-A-V2-BRIEF.md). Pump coordinates, mm. TEST ONLY, water only.

notch.purpose: board absent: clears the 4 mm pinion end (x 32.66) on the motor axis

tongue.purpose: carries the lock detector switch on its UNDERSIDE

antenna_wing_max.purpose: optional: the board may extend between y 36.3 and this edge for the HJ-840 antenna end (>= 3 mm from the cell, away from water and motor)

far.x_note: x = the strips the board was routed against (kept for the electronics rebuild); the housing now uses only x_bottom_ledge / x_top_clamp
far.why: v2.1 for the routed board: USB-C at x 42 (tab slot x 47.0-48.2 free), HJ-840 crosses on top over x 54.2-59.0

rear_stop.note: the rear edge bears on a stop at x 31.97-32.5 (bottom half) for y 18.84-21.0

height_limits.top_why: cell above (z 12.26) on a 0.5 foam pad
height_limits.bottom_why: floor at z 1.2 (v2.3: the board sits 1.16 higher in the shell with the FACE4 bore height, same place relative to the bore)

bottom_boss_zone.why: v2.2: no head boss any more (the lock face is part of the halves)

usb_c.type: mid-mount 16p (TYPE-C-31-M-14 class), receptacle centred on the PCB mid-plane = the housing seam; opening in the far wall: stadium 9.44 x 3.76

sw1.type: top-actuated tactile <= 3.5 x 3.5 x 1.5, pressed by a printed plunger from the top face

led.type: RGB, top-emitting, under a d2 light pipe

tmag5273.why: beside the angle magnet in the 4 mm pinion's front bore (x 31.66-32.66, y 33.435, z 9.90)

lock_switch.actuator: lever toward +x on y 37.46: free 65.72, ON 64.68, end 64.18; d2 pin from the lock face (z 8.23) preloads it: tip 64.85 ball free, 64.48 locked (0.17 / 0.20 mm margins: bench-tune the pin length)

motor.part: J2 Molex PicoBlade 53261-0471, bottom, right angle (routed board)
motor.why: the leads run along the floor (notches z 1-5.2, y 34-37.5) to the rear-far corner, then under the board to the plug

cell.part: J3 Kyocera AVX 9175 2-way IDC, bottom (routed board)
cell.why: the cell lies above the board with its bare leads at the FRONT end; they drop past the board's front edge into the IDC

radio: HJ-840: antenna end at a board edge with >= 3 mm to the cell pouch (metal laminate: y <= 34.9 above the board), > 15 mm to the cartridge water (y <= 17) and to the motor (x <= 27.9); best spot: the antenna wing in the flare
